# U46: An admin exports everything, stops a goal and moves an owner by email in the workbook, loads it back to see exactly those changes, saves and undoes them; then fills in the emails people are missing

- **Belongs to:** the Spreadsheets module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `ONE-FORMAT`, `ROUND-TRIP`, `IMPORT-ACTIONS`, `PERSON-EMAIL`, `IMPORT-UNDO`
- **Budget:** at most 16 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Grace, at `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U46

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Grace (`grace`).
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- _Note:_ Export these goals, from the Goals screen (on a phone, in the Views menu).
- **Step.** Open the Views menu (the View sheet on a phone) at its Export these goals button.
- _Note:_ On a phone it's at the foot of the View sheet, which scrolls.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the Export these goals button is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the Export these goals button.
- **Check:** The “Export” dialog shows.
- **Check:** “Results” is shown in the “Export” dialog (else: the workbook does not say it has every sheet).
- **Step.** Press the “Other formats” button in the “Export” dialog.
- **Check:** “CSV files, zipped” is shown in the “Export” dialog (else: the zipped CSVs are not offered behind Other formats).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “export choices”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- A downloaded workbook as sheets of rows: and those sheets saved as a workbook again: what someone editing it in Excel does, done with the same libraries the app uses (`readWorkbook(file)`, where `` const file = path.join(OUT, `U46-${device}.xlsx`) ``).
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `['Start here', 'Goals', 'Plan', 'Check-ins', 'People', 'Results', 'Asks', 'Notes'].every((n) => book.some((s) => s.name === n))`, where `` const file = path.join(OUT, `U46-${device}.xlsx`) ``; `const book = await readWorkbook(file)`. Else it says: the workbook has {book.map((s) => s.name).join(', ')}.
- _Note:_ In Excel: stop one goal (with a reason) and give another a new owner by email; a line break in a Why.
- Make the workbook to load, its sheets and rows as `writeWorkbook(book, edited)`, where `` const file = path.join(OUT, `U46-${device}.xlsx`) ``; `const book = await readWorkbook(file)`; `` const edited = path.join(OUT, `U46-${device}-edited.xlsx`) ``.
- Press the Escape key.
- _Note:_ Load it back on Data's Import: exactly those two changes, the stop shown as such, before anything is saved.
- Go to `/data` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the data import in the data tools (`.data-tools .data-import`).
- **Check:** “Add or change goals, plans, check-ins and people from a spreadsheet.” is shown.
- Choose a file to load in the “Choose a spreadsheet” field; the file is `edited`, where `` const edited = path.join(OUT, `U46-${device}-edited.xlsx`) ``.
- **Check:** “1 goal changed, 1 goal stopped” is shown (else: the preview does not say exactly the two changes).
- **Check:** “Read Goals, Plan, Check-ins, People and Metrics” is shown (else: the preview does not say which sheets it read).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “import preview”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Show the 2 changes” link.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/data/import/check/changes”.
- **Check:** A change in the import’s preview shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) there are 1 of a change in the import’s preview showing {stop.title} and there are 1 of a change in the import’s preview showing {move.title} (else: the changes do not name both goals).
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `(await h.snapshot()).goals.find((g) => g.id === stop.id) && !(await h.snapshot()).changes.some((c) => c.action === 'stopped')`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const stop = s0.goals.find((g) => g.ownerId === 'mateo' && s0.checkIns.some((c) => c.goalId === g.id) && !s0.goals.some((c) => c.parentId === g.id))`. Else it says: something was saved before Save.
- **Step.** Press the “Save 2 changes” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/data/import/done/imp_”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!!stopped.stoppedAt && stopped.stopReason === 'Folded into the incident review goal for the rest of the year.' && moved.ownerId === 'rhea'`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const stop = s0.goals.find((g) => g.ownerId === 'mateo' && s0.checkIns.some((c) => c.goalId === g.id) && !s0.goals.some((c) => c.parentId === g.id))`; `const move = s0.goals.find((g) => g.ownerId === 'tariq' && g.id !== stop.id)`; `const s1 = await h.snapshot()`; `const stopped = (s1.goals.find((g) => g.id === stop.id) || {})`; `const moved = s1.goals.find((g) => g.id === move.id)`. Else it says: stopped {!!stopped.stoppedAt}, owner {moved.ownerId}.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `!!imp && /Loaded a spreadsheet: 1 goal changed, 1 goal stopped/.test(imp.summary) && s1.changes.some((c) => c.importId === imp.entityId && c.action === 'stopped')`, where `const s1 = await h.snapshot()`; `const imp = s1.changes.filter((c) => c.action === 'imported').pop()`. Else it says: the import and the stop were not logged together.
- _Note:_ Undo it from Activity: both put back.
- Go to `/activity?kind=imports` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Undo this import” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Undo N rows” button in a dialog.
- **Check:** “Undone:” is shown (else: the undo does not say it was done).
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!s2.goals.find((g) => g.id === stop.id).stoppedAt && s2.goals.find((g) => g.id === move.id).ownerId === 'tariq'`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const stop = s0.goals.find((g) => g.ownerId === 'mateo' && s0.checkIns.some((c) => c.goalId === g.id) && !s0.goals.some((c) => c.parentId === g.id))`; `const move = s0.goals.find((g) => g.ownerId === 'tariq' && g.id !== stop.id)`; `const s2 = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: the undo did not put both goals back.
- _Note:_ Workspace: someone added before emails existed is listed, and their email saved.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `async () => { const s = await window.__goalsStore.load('platform-org'); const wen = s.people.find((x) => x.id === 'wen'); await window.__goalsStore.commit('platform-org', { people: [{ ...wen, email: null }], changes: [] }); }`.
- Go to `/people` in the demo.
- **Check:** “1 person has no email yet.” is shown (else: People does not say someone has no email).
- **Step.** Press the “Add them” button.
- **Check:** “People without an email · 1” is shown (else: Workspace does not list the person without an email).
- **Step.** Type “Wen.Zhao@example.com” into the “Wen Zhao: email” field.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “missing emails”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Save 1 email” button.
- **Check:** “Saved 1 email” is shown.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s3.people.find((x) => x.id === 'wen').email === 'wen.zhao@example.com' && s3.changes.some((c) => c.entity === 'person' && c.entityId === 'wen' && c.diffs.some((d) => d.field === 'Email'))`, where `const s3 = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: the email was not saved, lower case, and logged.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
